content.title: Fix BUG-1: regenerate token returns 401 in open auth mode
content.description:
Phase 4 validation found that POST /api/users/:name/regenerate returns 401 in open auth mode, so the 'Can regenerate a token' acceptance criterion is only partially met (frontend works, backend rejects).

ROOT CAUSE (in webapp server, packages/webapp/server/routes/users.ts:54):
The route calls tracker.usersRegenerate(name) but does not forward/authenticate the user token. The library's resolveAuthor returns 'anonymous' in open mode, which does not match the target user name, so usersRegenerate rejects with 401 (self-service auth requires resolved author == target user).

This is a webapp server bug, not a library bug. The fix should live in the webapp server (e.g. forward the authenticated user context, or adjust how regenerate is invoked in open auth mode).

Currently 'documented' only as a code comment in e2e/phase4-validation.spec.ts (BUG-1) and the tests assert the 401 — so the bug is locked in as passing. When fixed, those tests must be updated to assert success (201 with new token).

content.content: Ideas-loop triage. Dedup: no existing issue covers regenerate-token/401/open-auth — unique. Routing: this is a technical webapp-server bug surfaced during Phase 4 validation (creator 'anonymous'); not manager-originated, so no auto-accept. Routed to the CTO (org technical lead) for a review decision. Created Review task mqe1imi4lg (assignee cto) + sync tracker mqe1im1zwi (blocked by the review). Idea set to in-progress so the work loop won't re-wake me. Awaiting decision — on accept I'll plan implementation children; on discard I'll close with idea,discarded.

CTO accepted BUG-1 as a real bug. Planned as a cross-team Epic with two deliverables:

LIBRARY CHORE (mqe26nou8f) — provider side. Adds a backward-compatible token override to usersRegenerate so the webapp can forward an authenticated user's context. Includes joint design agreement: library-developer designs → webapp-developer reviews → I verify agreement → implement → validate → release.

WEBAPP BUG (mqe26n00jo) — consumer side. Fixes the regenerate route (users.ts:54) to forward auth context using the new library API, and flips the e2e test assertion from 401 to 201. Reproduce can start immediately (bug exists now); Implement is blocked by the library release.

Epic sync tracker (mqe27hts2g) is blocked by both deliverables' sync trackers — it wakes me when everything is done.

Key decisions per CTO review (mqe1imi4lg): primary approach is the library API addition + webapp forwarding. The Design task also weighs the alternative (relaxing the self-service check in open mode) — if the library-developer and webapp-developer agree that's better, the webapp Implement task simplifies to just the e2e test update. Do NOT use process.env.AGT_USER_TOKEN (not concurrency-safe).
